gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-public-sans: Baloo Paaji 2 stands tall and bold up top, its lowercase rising with its shapes held open. Public Sans takes over below with a hefty lowercase and broad counters, though a tiny heading would waste that headline presence.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-ranade: Ranade spreads its sans-serif line wide, with stroke ends set far apart and weight that shifts only slightly. Baloo Paaji 2 sits above it, towering and bold, its low-contrast strokes making a sharp foil; try the body a notch larger.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, a thick, heavy band of sans text through the middle of the line. Baloo Paaji 2 is the one for commanding, towering display, while Supreme does its best work keeping the lines underneath dense and steady.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-general-sans: Big, bold, then smooth and level. Baloo Paaji 2 brings a towering lowercase to the top, while General Sans follows with an x-height that fills the line and an unbroken pen pressure from start to finish.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-manrope: Baloo Paaji 2 towers with a tall lowercase, its shapes held open instead of curled shut, and it carries real command. Manrope's uniform lines keep it friendly.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-montserrat: Montserrat reads geometric and friendly, with generous space leading into every curve. Over many paragraphs it glides along smoothly, its oversized e and a counters keeping the line open, while Baloo Paaji 2 stays out of the way above.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-satoshi: Approachable, first of all. Satoshi brings a soaring x-height and a wide e that never looks squeezed, and Baloo Paaji 2 adds a towering, commanding lowercase above it, so the page gets loud on top and easy underneath.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-switzer: Baloo Paaji 2 brings a towering, commanding lowercase with its shapes held open rather than curled shut. Switzer follows in tubular, wire-like sans-serif letters with a tall waist line, and the two share stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-work-sans: Work Sans reads contemporary, its c tips held apart and its mean line set high above the baseline. Baloo Paaji 2 brings the commanding, towering lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-archivo: Baloo Tamma 2 is the commanding one, with big counters in a tall lowercase that never snag on a closed-up bowl. Archivo takes the quieter job below, its sans curves opening outward and its x-height doing the steady, editorial work.
